# PART 3 – The reproduction {#part-3-the-reproduction .darkslide background-color="rgba(0,0,0,0)"}

::: {.partlabel}
Part 3
:::

::: notes
Welcome back. In this part the ideas of the morning meet the code. You reproduce the value recorded in the robustness study for one of the five analysts, the one that I give you, from the public file of the original study, and find out why your number comes out exactly as it does. We then ask what a reproduction needs besides the data and the code, and where the reproduction of this paper reaches its limit. At the end we set the five reproductions of the class side by side, which leads into the last part.
:::
